sets.title: Puzzle 1: 3 speakers: who is truthful?
sets.text:
3 villagers of a hill village (Yamini, Anitha, Ramesh) are each either a truth-teller (always speaks the truth) or a liar (always lies). Each makes exactly one statement:
1. Yamini says: "Ramesh and Anitha are both liars."
2. Anitha says: "Yamini is a liar."
3. Ramesh says: "Anitha is a liar."

sets.title: Puzzle 2: 3 speakers: who is truthful?
sets.text:
3 villagers of a hill village (Priya, Ishita, Gopal) are each either a truth-teller (always speaks the truth) or a liar (always lies). Each makes exactly one statement:
1. Priya says: "At least 2 of us 3 are liars."
2. Ishita says: "At least one of Gopal and Priya is a liar."
3. Gopal says: "At most 1 of us 3 is a liar."

sets.title: Puzzle 3: 3 speakers: who is truthful?
sets.text:
3 players in a cricket squad (Deepa, Sneha, Jayant) are each either a truth-teller (always speaks the truth) or a liar (always lies). Each makes exactly one statement:
1. Deepa says: "Jayant is a liar."
2. Sneha says: "Jayant and Deepa are both liars."
3. Jayant says: "Exactly 2 of us 3 are liars."

sets.title: Puzzle 4: 4 speakers: who is truthful?
sets.text:
4 villagers of a hill village (Sunita, Harish, Bharat, Meera) are each either a truth-teller (always speaks the truth) or a liar (always lies). Each makes exactly one statement:
1. Sunita says: "Bharat and Harish are of the same type."
2. Harish says: "At least one of Sunita and Bharat is a liar."
3. Bharat says: "Exactly 1 of us 4 is a liar."
4. Meera says: "Sunita is truthful."

sets.title: Puzzle 5: 4 speakers: who is truthful?
sets.text:
4 suspects questioned by an inspector (Divya, Priya, Ramesh, Pooja) are each either a truth-teller (always speaks the truth) or a liar (always lies). Each makes exactly one statement:
1. Divya says: "Priya and Pooja are both truthful."
2. Priya says: "At most 2 of us 4 are liars."
3. Ramesh says: "Priya is a liar."
4. Pooja says: "At most 3 of us 4 are liars."

sets.title: Puzzle 6: 4 speakers: who is truthful?
sets.text:
4 suspects questioned by an inspector (Bharat, Kiran, Vikram, Sunita) are each either a truth-teller (always speaks the truth) or a liar (always lies). Each makes exactly one statement:
1. Bharat says: "Exactly 2 of us 4 are liars."
2. Kiran says: "Sunita and Bharat are both truthful."
3. Vikram says: "Kiran and Sunita are of the same type."
4. Sunita says: "At least one of Kiran and Bharat is a liar."

sets.title: Puzzle 7: 4 speakers: who is truthful?
sets.text:
4 suspects questioned by an inspector (Priya, Sunita, Divya, Meera) are each either a truth-teller (always speaks the truth) or a liar (always lies). Each makes exactly one statement:

2. Sunita says: "Meera is a liar."
3. Divya says: "Meera and Sunita are both truthful."
4. Meera says: "At least one of Divya and Priya is a liar."

sets.title: Puzzle 8: 4 speakers: who is truthful?
sets.text:
4 suspects questioned by an inspector (Arjun, Karthik, Dinesh, Uma) are each either a truth-teller (always speaks the truth) or a liar (always lies). Each makes exactly one statement:

2. Karthik says: "Uma is truthful."
3. Dinesh says: "At least 2 of us 4 are liars."
4. Uma says: "Exactly 3 of us 4 are liars."

sets.title: Puzzle 9: 5 speakers: who is truthful?
sets.text:
5 villagers of a hill village (Rohit, Saravanan, Tarun, Bharat, Omkar) are each either a truth-teller (always speaks the truth) or a liar (always lies). Each makes exactly one statement:

sets.title: Puzzle 10: 5 speakers: who is truthful?
sets.text:
5 villagers of a hill village (Jagan, Madhavi, Venkat, Uma, Arjun) are each either a truth-teller (always speaks the truth) or a liar (always lies). Each makes exactly one statement:
1. Jagan says: "Exactly 4 of us 5 are liars."
2. Madhavi says: "Uma and Venkat are both truthful."
3. Venkat says: "Uma and Arjun are both truthful."
4. Uma says: "Jagan is a liar."
5. Arjun says: "Madhavi and Jagan are both liars."
